name: lift-fixture-prepare
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT="$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR"; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/lift-regression-prepare-all.ts > "$OUT/prepare.log" 2>&1

name: lift-regression-unit
cmd: set -euo pipefail; OUT="$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR"; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun test research/bapa/lift-regression.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1
